builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 W deals 16% enemy max HP over 0.75s; level-18 Brittle adds the source's level-scaled max-HP magic packet when legally detonated. Neither has a direct AP coefficient. The physical attack used to trigger Brittle is a separate delivery packet.

Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by [40 / 50 / 60]% for [3] seconds.

Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. The elemental also deals [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and reapplies Brittle.
